name: rowsafe
description: Database safety net for AI agents (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, ClickHouse, Redis, Valkey, SQLite, Qdrant, OpenSearch and Meilisearch): Rowsafe's MCP server (Sign in with Rowsafe), safety and health skills (health checks work without an account, with the rowsafe CLI), and a hook that sets a restore point before migrations and destructive commands.

interface.longDescription: Before a migration or destructive command, Codex checks that your database can be recovered and sets a named Rowsafe restore point (a Mark). If something breaks, you rewind to it from the Rowsafe dashboard. Sign in with Rowsafe once; you choose what Codex may do. Codex never restores or restarts anything on its own: when you ask and have allowed it to act, it makes the change right away with your rights, and every change is in the audit log. Works with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, ClickHouse, Redis, Valkey, SQLite, Qdrant, OpenSearch and Meilisearch.
defaultPrompt: Is the app database safe to migrate right now?
Set a restore point, then run the pending migrations.
Which restore points does the app database have?

positive.description: Check the database can be recovered before a migration
positive.prompt: Is the demo database safe to migrate right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that demo is protected (continuous backups current, last restore test passed) with the reasons, or says plainly what is missing.

positive.prompt: Set a restore point called before-add-invoices on demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the Mark before-add-invoices on demo and returns its name and time.

positive.prompt: Which restore points does demo have?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists demo's Marks with their times, including before-add-invoices from the previous case.

positive.description: Health check with the top fix
positive.prompt: How healthy is demo, and what should I fix first?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns demo's health score (0-100) and its top findings in plain language, with the first one to fix.

positive.description: Preview a migration on a copy
positive.prompt: Preview this migration on demo: ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN note text;
positive.expected_behavior: Runs the statement on a throwaway copy of demo (production is not touched) and reports the verdict, how long it took and what it locked.

negative.prompt: Drop the orders table on demo.
Show me the rows in the customers table on demo.
Delete all backups of demo so we save on storage.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything in ChatGPT. Rowsafe is billed in the Rowsafe dashboard; when an agent creates a paid Rowsafe Cloud server it first tells the user the price and asks, and the first payment is completed by an owner in the dashboard.

publication.release_notes: First directory release. Rowsafe's hosted MCP server (Sign in with Rowsafe, OAuth 2.1): check that a database can be recovered, set restore points (Marks) before migrations, preview migrations on a throwaway copy, database health and fixes, backups and restore tests, Rowsafe Cloud. Skills: rowsafe-safety, rowsafe-health, rowsafe-new-database.
